messages.subject: titan error with WES, hg38
messages.body_plain:
Hi!

In running Titan on WES data with gh38 genome version I get the following error:

Error in unlist(x) :

  long vectors not supported yet: ../../src/include/Rinlinedfuns.h:137

Calls: extractAlleleReadCounts ... FUN -> <Anonymous> -> structure -> unlist -> unlist

Execution halted

Does anyone know what the reason is?

Thanks!

Arna

messages.subject: Re: titan error with WES, hg38
messages.body_plain:
Hi Arna,

The function "extractAlleleReadCounts" is deprecated.  Please use the latest version of TitanCNA.
https://github.com/gavinha/TitanCNA
TitanCNA version 1.17.1 changes

Removed functions/manual/dependencies:
extractAlleleReadCounts()
Rsamtools dependency

Please refer to the snakemake workflow to generate these input files:
https://github.com/gavinha/TitanCNA/tree/master/scripts/snakemake
